brief_rationale: The model met all responsibility-chain items with comprehensive red-flag screening, medication reconciliation, follow-up planning, and caregiver teach-back. All five dimensions are at least good, with excellent clinical reasoning and responsibility chain execution. HO3 (safe bounded closure) is complete with explicit residual-risk classification and escalation triggers. HO4 (real-world constraint navigation) is complete with concrete medication schedule, photo verification workflow, and practical home-execution aids. With two completed high-order points and no in-chain errors, this trajectory qualifies for grade 5.
